title: Single build server
description: All releases depend on one CI server with no tested rebuild
mitigation: Rebuild CI from code and test the rebuild every quarter

title: Unsigned release artefacts
description: Production cannot verify that images came from CI
mitigation: Sign images in CI and verify signatures at deploy

title: Supplier exit untested
description: Hosted identity provider has no tested exit plan
mitigation: Export users and test restore on an alternative provider

title: Pilot slows delivery
description: Transition pilot may raise change lead time for the pilot team
mitigation: Stop condition in charter: stop if lead time is 20% worse after 8 weeks

title: Personal data in test environments
description: Copies of production data used for testing
mitigation: Synthetic or masked test data only; block production copies
